about_the_game:
In the magical world of Fantasy Brawl, each hero possesses unique skills and combat styles. Carefully select 5 heroes to form your dream team and showcase your strategic wisdom in automatic battle arenas.

🎯 **Core Features**
• Auto-Battle Mode - Focus on pre-battle formation and character synergy strategies
• 50+ Powerful Equipment - Create unlimited tactical combinations through free customization
• Unique Skill System - Each hero has exclusive active and passive abilities
• Deep Strategic Gameplay - Front-line tanks protect back-line damage dealers with class synergy

⚔️ **Combat Experience**
In intense 5v5 battles, you must strategically position front-line tanks, back-line damage dealers, and support characters. Through equipment combinations and skill synergies, create the perfect formation that matches your tactical style. Every battle is a test of your strategic thinking!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Fantasy Brawl is a strategic auto-battle game with 20+ unique heroes and 50+ equipment system. Show tactical wisdom in 5v5 battles through strategic positioning and character synergy. Stunning visuals and smooth combat immerse you in fantasy world strategic duels.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Korean
